key_insight: Fully quantum Quantum Hamiltonian Descent trains parametric circuits by encoding parameters in a quantum wavefunction that explores the cost landscape and can tunnel toward global minima.
engineering_relevance: Grid-resolution-independent simulation error bounds and gate-count-aware schedules offer a principled route to implementing quantum circuit training.
method: Use parameter-register qubits to coherently control a circuit on a second register.
Evolve parameters under kinetic and cost-potential terms with tunable schedules.
Reduce schedule design to one curve governing adiabaticity and use remaining freedom to minimize gate count.
evidence_signal: Simulations on benchmark functions and parametric circuits show markedly higher global-minimum success probabilities at equal cost with the proposed schedules.
watch_item: Evidence is simulation-based; practical performance under hardware noise and coherent-control overhead remains unestablished.
paper_title: Fully quantum training of parametric circuits with Quantum Hamiltonian Descent
